evidence.text: A person 亻 making something for the first time 乍; 乍 also provides the pronunciation
Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 乍 represents the sound.

Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声, OC *ʔsaːɡs, *ʔsaːɡs, *ʔsaːɡ): semantic 亻 (“man”) + phonetic 乍 (OC *zraːɡs).
Derivative: 做 (“to do”) (the departing-tone variant).
make; work; compose, write; act, perform
